NEWS

We joined NVIDIA Inception.

Skilak has been accepted into NVIDIA Inception. We will use it to test local inference on NVIDIA hardware more thoroughly.

Thank you to the NVIDIA Inception team.

Read the announcement
Member of NVIDIA Inception

MANIFESTO

What we believe
01
Own your AI like you own your computer.

You bought the machine. The model runs on it. Nobody can change the terms, raise the price, or switch it off.

02
Open source is for everyone. We do the hard part.

The best models and tools are already free. Making them run well, safely, on your own hardware is not. That part is our job.

03
Nobody makes money off your data. Not vendors, not clouds, not us.

We collect only what the system needs to run. Nothing about you or your documents leaves the perimeter.

04
Capable AI should be affordable.

You should not need a million-dollar contract to run a capable model. Affordable self-hosted AI is the point, not a tier.

05
A private AI has a perimeter.

What goes in stays in. That line is drawn in hardware and network, not in a policy PDF.

PRODUCTS

Two products, one idea

One keeps everything in. The other keeps your data out of everyone else's model.

Keep

AI that keeps everything in.

A private AI server for your office. Chat, documents, and open models on hardware you own. Arrives silent, proven silent at your firewall.

Meet Keep
Illustrative depiction only
Hardware configured to client specification.
Mesh

Keeps your data out of other people's AI.

A gateway on your computer that inspects what your AI tools send out, and stops secrets and personal data before they leave.

Meet Mesh

OUR PROMISE

Our promise on data

We collect only what the system needs to run. We never sell, share, or train on your data. If that ever changes, you will read it here first.

Read the full promise
Who this is for
Firms whose files cannot leave

Law firms, clinics, and defense contractors whose privileged, patient, or controlled data cannot go near a public model. Keep puts the model in your building.

Meet Keep
Engineers using cloud AI tools

Teams in Claude Code or Codex who want API keys and personal data removed before a prompt leaves the laptop. Mesh runs on each computer.

Meet Mesh

Skilak Keep and Skilak Mesh are designed to fit within a customer's CMMC, HIPAA, ITAR, or other security program. Skilak LLC does not certify or confer compliance.

TALK TO US

Tell us what you would run.

Email us, or request a pilot. A few lines about the workload is enough.
